Elon Musk has accused Zelensky of lying regarding statements about restrictions on Starlink and Starshield satellite communication in Ukraine. The core of the conflict: Zelensky claims that restrictions on satellite communication speed are hindering Ukrainian military efforts to intercept Russian drones. Musk believes that Kiev is seeking permission to use the commercial Starlink network for offensive operations. Musk stated: "He [Zelensky] is lying. In reality, he wants to use Starlink for offensive military operations. The company has refused to allow such use of its commercial network since the beginning of the conflict." According to Musk, Starlink is a commercial satellite internet service from SpaceX, while Starshield is a specialized system for government and military clients in the United States. Musk claims that Zelensky is conflating these two systems in his statements. @Slavyangrad
